title: The Magic of Friendship

scenes.summary: Three friends find a key and a treasure map.
scenes.text: Lily found a golden key and with her friends discovered a treasure map.
scenes.image_prompt: kids holding golden key and map near tree, magical cartoon

scenes.summary: They follow the map through different paths.
scenes.text: They traveled through the garden and climbed a hill to find the treasure.
scenes.image_prompt: kids walking through garden and hill, adventure cartoon

scenes.text: They entered a forest and followed clues while helping each other.
scenes.image_prompt: kids exploring forest together, bright cartoon

scenes.text: They found a wooden box and opened it to see a glowing globe.
scenes.image_prompt: kids opening glowing treasure box with globe, magical cartoon

scenes.summary: They realize friendship is the real treasure.
scenes.text: They understood that friendship was the greatest treasure and returned home happy.
scenes.image_prompt: kids hugging and smiling together, warm cartoon

story: Lily, Jack, and Emily found a golden key and a treasure map. They followed the map through the garden and forest. After working together, they found a treasure box with a glowing globe. They realized friendship was the greatest treasure and returned home happy.
